The '''Colonial Station Cam'co system''' was located in the core territory of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], the government of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that governed the Chiss Space area of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was connected by the [[Chasdemonus Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Naporar system/Legends|Naporar system]] and to regions lying northwest of the Chiss Ascendancy's core territory. The Colonial Station Cam'co system was [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the Chiss,<ref name="TEA" /> and it was one of the two [[Star/Legends|star]] systems named after [[Jer'Jo Cam'Co]], one of the founding [[Syndic/Legends|syndics]], or leaders, of the Chiss Ascendancy's [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Expansionary Defense Fleet]].<ref name="NJO">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The two Chiss Space star systems named after Jer'Jo Cam'co were first mentioned in [[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee|''Refugee'']], the second entry in the [[Force Heretic trilogy|''Force Heretic'' trilogy]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' novel series. The [[2003]] novel was authored by [[Sean Williams]] and [[Shane Dix]].<ref name="NJO" /> One of those systems was then identified as the Colonial Station Cam'co system by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which also placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
